_meta.title: Forms -> SharePoint 'Knowledge Submissions' mapping specification

confidence_states.Existing: Preserved from a working flow mapping (requires 04-existing-flow evidence).
confidence_states.Confirmed: Supported by authoritative structural, distinctive dummy-test, or unique label-match evidence.
confidence_states.Probable: Strongly suggested but unproved; requires human resolution; NEVER executable.

_meta.executability_rule: executable == true requires forms side AND SharePoint side each Existing/Confirmed, with every expression source evidenced. Enforced by scripts/validate_spec.py and scripts/generate_artifacts.py.
layer_model: 1 raw Forms answers (from Get response details only)
3 human review and governance (blank/defaults at creation)
4 processing and audit metadata (set by the flow)
